message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a man in a white shirt, dark trousers, and black-and-white sneakers climbing a silver step-ladder. He is shown from the side, reaching up to arrange rectangular placards. He holds a pink placard labeled "KEMENTERIAN INDUSTRI KREATIF" in both hands. Behind him, dozens of other rectangles in shades of purple and pink are scattered across the background, overlapping each other. Many contain text such as "KEMENTERIAN INVESTASI," "BADAN RISET NASIONAL," and "KEMENTERIAN EKONOMI DIGITAL."

Large magenta text at the bottom reads "ATUR-ATUR NOMENKLATUR." Below this, a block of black text begins with "JOKOWI BERENCANA." The top of the image features the masthead "TEMPO" in large, translucent pink letters. Smaller black text at the top reads "SIAPA MENYULUT PAPUA" and "DALAM SERBUAN KOSMETIK SELUNDUPAN." A red vertical bar borders the left side. The bottom right corner contains a barcode, price information, and the date "26 AGUSTUS-SEPTEMBER 2019." The man’s posture is dynamic, with one foot on a ladder rung and the other on a lower step.
